phase: Before this experiment's outcomes; after inspecting v0.1.0 outcomes.
selection: Original metadata-only 42-series cross-family selection; all 3 models, widths 30, 100, 300.
source_scores: Unchanged released vectors, including documented zero padding.
timing: Whole-call validation and preprocessing included; JIT warmup excluded. One thread; random method order in each repetition; serial timings.
baseline_comparison: Actual fast-VUS returns PR only; Sparse VUS computes both ROC and PR, so this comparison favors fast-VUS.
reporting: All cases and regressions; no timing substitution from old runs; float64 numerical audit is not directed-rounding certification.
